name: Localization Release
description: Take a product or content release from source freeze through translation, locale QA, functional review, and launch readiness.

tasks.name: Define locale scope
tasks.objective: List target locales, content surfaces, source version, glossary/style guides, variables, plural rules, legal strings, images, dates/numbers/currency, accessibility text, and release constraints.

tasks.name: Prepare localization kit
tasks.objective: Normalize source strings, remove ambiguity where possible, freeze keys, provide context/screenshots, define do-not-translate tokens, terminology, tone, and fallback behavior.

tasks.name: Translate and adapt
tasks.objective: Translate for meaning and locale conventions while preserving placeholders, markup, product terminology, register, inclusivity, and required legal wording.

tasks.name: Run linguistic QA
tasks.objective: Review grammar, terminology, consistency, truncation risk, cultural fit, punctuation, variables, pluralization, dates/numbers/currency, and source-text defects.

tasks.name: Run in-product locale QA
tasks.objective: Exercise localized builds for rendering, clipping, RTL behavior where relevant, sorting, search, input, links, images, accessibility labels, fallback strings, and locale-specific workflows.

tasks.name: Publish locale readiness report
tasks.objective: Record approved locales, blockers, known exceptions, deferred strings, screenshots, regression cases, ownership, and rollback/fallback instructions.
